name: 93257 · Porterville, CA
findings: ZIP 93257 (Porterville) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93257 (Porterville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93257 (Porterville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
